video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Cade Cunningham

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the preseason performance of his teammates
quotes.excerpt: Get to see him back out there having fun with the group. I thought he played great.
quotes.quote: I thought it was amazing. Get to see him back out there having fun with the group. I thought he played great. I thought he had a great aggression, looked sharp, and I think that's a big year.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham says he is impressed with his teammates' preseason performance, noting that one player in particular looked sharp and played with great aggression.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the benefits of having versatile teammates
quotes.excerpt: Having guys that you can throw it anywhere around the rim and they'll go figure it out.
quotes.quote: It makes my job a lot easier. It's fun for me, having guys that you can throw it anywhere around the rim and they'll go figure it out for you. So, it makes my life easier, makes it a lot of fun, and I think it makes us more dangerous, getting out on the break and running.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham believes the Pistons are more dangerous this year, saying having versatile teammates who can finish around the rim makes his job a lot easier.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on team cohesion and building chemistry
quotes.excerpt: There's a good cohesiveness about the group. We got to play together more.
quotes.quote: I felt that way coming in. I think there's a good cohesiveness about the group. We got to play together more and get more synergy amongst each other, but I think it's a good group. I think we fit each other well, and I think we're only helping each other.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham likes the current chemistry in Detroit, stating that the group fits well together and they are focused on building synergy as the season approaches.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on maintaining a competitive edge
quotes.excerpt: It just keeps us on edge. You can never get too comfortable.
quotes.quote: I think it just keeps us on edge. You can never get too comfortable. The East has gotten better, the league has gotten better. It's a new year, so everybody is back 0-0. It's still about starting off strong and finding our footing through the year and continuing to get better as the year goes on.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham says the improved competition in the Eastern Conference keeps the Pistons on edge, noting that you can never get too comfortable in this league.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the excitement of early season competition
quotes.excerpt: I love the competition. I know we all love the competition. That's what we grew up loving.
quotes.quote: It's a blessing, man. It's a blessing. I love the competition. I know we all love the competition. That's what we grew up loving about the game. So, to be able to start the year off like that, it's only going to make us better for the season, and it's exciting. You want to play against the best.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham on the start of the new season: It is a blessing to be able to compete against the best.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the team's offensive philosophy
quotes.excerpt: It makes us be able to play a better tempo and get us easier shots.
quotes.quote: I think it's good. I feel good about it. I think it makes us be able to play a better tempo and get us easier shots, no matter who's on the floor. So, I think that's the main thing is whatever group he puts out there, we can all find a style that we all can play with, and I think it's going to be good for everybody.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham says the Pistons' offensive philosophy is designed to play at a better tempo and generate easier shots regardless of who is on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the team being overlooked
quotes.excerpt: I still feel like we're a little slept on, man. I still feel like people don't really give us.
quotes.quote: I still feel like we're a little slept on, man. I still feel like people don't really give us the credit that maybe we have earned. But again, that's the beauty of it. I think that's part of being in Detroit. I think that's part of being a team that is young and people don't really expect much, versus other teams that have bigger names.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham says he still feels like the Pistons are slept on by the rest of the league, adding that it is part of the identity of being a young team in Detroit.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the impact of floor spacing
quotes.excerpt: More space allows you to go one-on-one, a lot easier, not as much help.
quotes.quote: More space allows you to go one-on-one, a lot easier, not as much help. I mean, that's the name of the game. You want to space the floor out, create advantages, and play the numbers game—three-on-two, two-on-ones, all those things. So, having space allows you to do that and allows you to make them pay with more threes. It's only going to help my game, it'll only help AT, it'll only help JD.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham explains how better floor spacing will help his game and his teammates, noting that it creates advantages and forces defenses to pay for leaving shooters open.

quotes.speaker: Cade Cunningham
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham on the playmaking of his teammates
quotes.excerpt: AT is somebody that passes the ball at a super high level, can handle the ball.
quotes.quote: Easier shots, you'll be more efficient that way. AT is somebody that passes the ball at a super high level, can handle the ball. So, I think it's just natural for us to use him more in that light and allow him to explore more. He hasn't had enough of that in his time with us. So, I think it only makes my life easier and it adds more to his game that people have to respect and guard him a little bit differently.
quotes.social_post: Cade Cunningham says the team plans to utilize Ausar Thompson as a playmaker more this season, noting that his ability to pass and handle the ball adds a new dimension that defenses must respect.
